title: Brand Standards: Free Night Awards Walk Protection by Where the Replacement Is Used
content:
**Relocation guarantee clause.** When a member applies a replacement among the Free Night Awards to a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation, where the replacement is used decides how much of the walked night stays protected:

- when the reservation it pays is at the very hotel that relocated the stay, the night is priced at the walked-night protected price itself, whatever its season;
- when it is at another hotel of the same brand as the relocated stay, the whole walked-night discount is taken off the night's price;
- otherwise, at a hotel of another brand, the standard half of the walked-night discount, rounded down to a whole point, is taken off the night's price.

**Terms.** The walked-night discount is the price on the latest hold of the award the replacement replaces, the hold for its walked night, less the walked-night protected price on that award's latest return, the return from the relocated stay, never below zero. The walked-night protected price is the one stated on that return. The hotel and the brand of the relocated stay, and those of the reservation the replacement pays, are the hotel and brand on their Room Reservations records. The night's price is the award-chart price of the night of the reservation the replacement pays.

## Cases (hypothetical replacement: night price 30000 points; replaced award's latest hold 32000 points, latest return 24000 points, so a walked-night discount of 8000 points)

| Where the replacement is used | Price after walk protection |
|---|---|
| The very hotel that relocated the stay | 24000, the walked-night protected price itself |
| Another hotel of the same brand as the relocated stay | 22000: 30000 less the whole 8000 |
| A hotel of another brand | 26000: 30000 less half of 8000 |

At the very hotel the price is 24000 whatever the season of the night; a peak or an off-peak night there is priced the same.
